17:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NWSL Soccer
The Kansas City Current host the Washington Spirit in NWSL regular-season action at CPKC Stadium. On a three-game winning run with one matchday remaining, the Current welcome a Spirit side that beat them 4-0 earlier this season in April.
